main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 7-day return (coin mean 7-day return removed)

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 7-day return on forecast

decided_by: the t of the main measure is between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule)
reading: cases are grid bars (positions 0, 7, 14, ... of each window) with forecast > 0 and a 7-bar forward return inside the window; the t is the weighted mean over its day-clustered standard error (per day the sum of weight x deviation, with D/(D-1) correction); the plan's minimum of 30 distinct days is applied as 'not observable' as the workflow requires.
